description: Reports which AI crawlers may fetch a public URL. Reads the site's robots.txt and returns allowed or blocked, with the deciding rule, for each known AI crawler from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, Amazon and others, split into search and answer-time bots versus training bots. Also checks whether the server answers an automated request, noindex and nosnippet directives, declared sitemaps, Content-Signal lines and llms.txt. Use for "are we blocking GPTBot or ClaudeBot?", "can ChatGPT read this page?" or an AI crawler audit of robots.txt.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_ai_crawler_access
title: Check AI crawler access to a URL
